remarks: Welcome to the Harbor Ridge community! This spacious 3-bedroom, 2 bath townhome offers approximately 1,549 square feet of living space and one of the largest floor plans in the community. Step inside to a bright, open-concept design highlighted by soaring vaulted ceilings and abundant natural light, creating an impressive sense of openness and space. The comfortable living and dining areas provide an inviting setting for everyday living and entertaining, while the private enclosed patio extends the living space outdoors—perfect for relaxing, dining or enjoying your morning coffee.
